traits: Cap 3 to 18 cm, ochre-orange to orange-brown, velvety to felty
Pores grey, the same colour as the tubes
Stem 3 to 20 cm, covered with dense black tufts
White flesh turning grey-pink then dark grey-violet when cut; mild taste, faint smell
safetyNote: Edible when well cooked: the DGfM lists it and the VAPKO lists the rough-stemmed boletes. Wikipedia (fr) says the fibrous stem is often thrown away and that rough-stemmed boletes upset the stomach if raw or undercooked; Wikipedia (en) calls it mildly toxic unless properly heated (15 to 20 minutes of frying or boiling), with nausea and vomiting. Flesh colour on cutting differs: pink to grey-violet (fr), reddish then brownish (en). It turns black when cooked.

sources.title: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Mykologie (DGfM), Fachausschuss Pilzverwertung und Toxikologie (2026). Positivliste der Speisepilze, Stand 1. Mai 2026.
VAPKO, Vereinigung amtlicher Pilzkontrollorgane der Schweiz (2023). Empfehlungsliste (liste des champignons recommandés), version 09.2023.
